description.value: Second Slice Pizza is a late-night pizza counter on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, built around fresh multigrain dough made daily and an extensive by-the-slice menu. It offers classic, gourmet, and vegetarian pies alongside a 'take & bake' option for those with access to an oven. Its central location and very late closing hours make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists finishing a long day in the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (1322 Douglas St, Victoria BC V8W 2E8), phone (250-385-1000), and business name. Takeout/pickup is explicitly confirmed via 'Pick up your pizza in person' and a dedicated 'Pickup Specials' menu section. The menu lists identifiable vegetarian pizzas (Superb Veggie, Greek Pizza, Pesto Fiesta). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed-open, centrally located pizza takeout spot in downtown Victoria with vegetarian options and very late hours; a practical food stop for touring cyclists passing through the city core.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian pizzas: Superb Veggie (tomato sauce, green peppers, onions, mushrooms, black olives, tomatoes, mozzarella), Greek Pizza, and Pesto Fiesta. No explicit vegan or gluten-free options mentioned

wow_evidence: late-night pizza counter on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria
